project_type: Manifest V3 browser extension: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite 8 + @crxjs/vite-plugin 3. Floating Shadow-DOM React overlay for bilingual English/Bengali vocabulary lookup, offline-first with concurrent Groq/OpenRouter/Gemini AI lookups proxied through the MV3 service worker.
language: TypeScript (src) + JSX/TSX (UI); build scripts in ESM .mjs
build_system: Vite 8 + @crxjs/vite-plugin 3 (feeds source manifest.json directly; CRXJS rewrites .ts entries to .js in dist/manifest.json). `npm run build` = `tsc -b && vite build` with `prebuild` running `npm run build:dictionary` (node scripts/build-dictionary.mjs). Dictionary alone: `npm run build:dictionary`. Quirk: project dir is NOT a git repository; .gitignore is inert. `import.meta.env.VITE_*` is statically inlined by Vite at build time — root cause of key leak. `import.meta.env.DEV` is statically replaced with `true` in `vite dev` and `false` in `vite build`.
test_framework: vitest 5 (`npm test` = `vitest run`). No vitest.config.ts — uses defaults. Default environment is 'node'. Tests live in `tests/` and import from `../src/...`. `tests/` is NOT in tsconfig.app.json include so `tsc -b` does NOT typecheck tests. Per-file jsdom env: add `// @vitest-environment jsdom` as the FIRST line of the test file (jsdom package must be installed). Use `vi.stubEnv(name, value)` + `vi.unstubAllEnvs()` + `vi.resetModules()` + dynamic `await import(...)` to control import.meta.env between tests.
verification_instructions: 1. `npm test` (only 3 pre-existing live-API tests in tests/groq-live.test.ts may skip). 2. `npx tsc -b` exit 0. 3. `npm run lint` exit 0 (oxlint). 4. `npm run build` exit 0, then PowerShell: `Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Path dist -Filter *.js | Select-String -SimpleMatch 'gsk_'` must return NO matches. 5. tests/overlay.test.tsx must pass and demonstrate offline->AI replacement.
snapshot_or_generated_files: src/dictionary/generated.json (~1.1MB columnar JSON, 6675 entries) and public/dictionary.json.gz (356KB) are build artifacts regenerated by `npm run build:dictionary`. They are imported by tests/offline.test.ts. Regenerate ONLY after changing scripts/lib/wordnet.mjs (FEAT-005 I3). Keep both in sync.
environment_constraints: Windows + PowerShell. Node v24. Do NOT run any git commands (directory is not a repo; task forbids it). Never print/log the gsk_ API key value — reference by variable name only. No new runtime dependencies; only testing devDependencies, pinned exact versions: @testing-library/react@16.3.3, @testing-library/dom@10.4.2, @testing-library/jest-dom@6.10.0, jsdom@30.1.3, fake-indexeddb@6.2.6. No @ts-ignore/@ts-nocheck/any to suppress TypeScript errors. oxlint config .oxlintrc.json enables react/rules-of-hooks (error) and react/only-export-components (warn, allowConstantExport). The `// @vitejs-environment jsdom` docblock must be the VERY FIRST line of overlay.test.tsx.
contribution_requirements: RULES.md: Strict TypeScript, no any unless justified; never hard-code secrets; API keys only in chrome.storage.local; one history entry per search action, update on AI replacement; stale responses ignored by requestId; debounce 300-500ms; offline-first; provider HTTP only via service worker; Shadow DOM isolation; least-privilege permissions; run typecheck/build/tests before claiming success.
key_patterns: Message contract constants in src/providers/bridge.ts (LOOKUP_MESSAGE, OFFLINE_LOOKUP_MESSAGE, LIST_MODELS_MESSAGE, SEED_MESSAGE). Coordinator (src/lookup/coordinator.ts) fans out offline + enabled AI providers concurrently, keeps the strictly-better result (isBetter: completeness score then priority groq>openrouter>gemini then recency), emits LOCAL_RESULT/AI_RESULT/LOOKUP_COMPLETE/LOOKUP_ERROR, drops stale by requestId. Provider lookups share buildUserPrompt/parseAiJson/isValidResult/fetchWithTimeout from src/providers/common.ts. Storage: chrome.storage.local for providers ('vocabflow.providers') and overlay geometry ('vocabflow.overlay'); new 'vocabflow.settings' for app settings; IndexedDB (DB 'vocabflow', store 'history', autoIncrement id) for HistoryEntry. Existing tests mock chrome.runtime.sendMessage and chrome.storage.local via globalThis.chrome (see tests/coordinator.test.ts, tests/seed.test.ts for the exact pattern). isBengali() is exported from src/providers/offline/dataset.ts (and re-exported from src/providers/offline/index.ts — verify the index.ts re-export before importing).
directory_structure: src/background (MV3 service worker), src/content (content-script entry, mounts overlay), src/ui (Overlay.tsx + views/ + mount.tsx + styles.ts), src/lookup (coordinator.ts), src/providers (common.ts, bridge.ts, groq/, openrouter/, gemini/, offline/), src/storage (settings.ts provider settings, history.ts IndexedDB, seed.ts, app-settings.ts [NEW]), src/config (env.ts), src/shared (types.ts), src/dictionary (generated.json 1.1MB build artifact + curated.json 14KB hand-curated), scripts/ (build-dictionary.mjs, lib/bengali.mjs, lib/wordnet.mjs), tests/ (vitest tests), manifest.json (source manifest for CRXJS), vite.config.ts (react() + crx({manifest}))
